products.name: Remind
products.note: Found in the research for The AI Ready School; not independently verified. AI features: not verified. Use: Class and school messaging. Who: Teachers, families. Student age: Not verified. Privacy: Not verified. Price: Remind Chat free; Remind Hub paid by quote (third party).

profile_text.body:
Remind describes itself as a communication platform for teachers and for organizations outside of K-12 schools and districts, including youth organizations, sports programs, and nonprofits. According to its site, K-12 schools and districts are served by ParentSquare. The platform offers two-way communication for everyone in a learning or community group, with oversight and controls such as access to message history logs.

On the AI side, the record is thin. Remind appears in the research for The AI Ready School as an education and research AI product, but that entry notes it was not independently verified and that its AI features are not verified. The same entry lists its use as class and school messaging, its users as teachers and families, and its price as Remind Chat free with Remind Hub paid by quote.

The site's material is mostly testimonials from users at a community college, a district, and classrooms, describing uses such as registration and deadline notices, campus alerts, community announcements, health and safety notices, and texting pictures to parents. No lawsuits, SEC filings, patents, or MCP servers are recorded for the company.
